description: Eyes closed, ears up. The Veteran has heard every alarm the treeline can sound and stopped flinching years ago. Foxwatch's steadiest paw on patrol.
name: The Veteran — Foxwatch Ranger

description: Wrapped in a road-worn scarf, the Wayfarer walks the far trails between Foxwatch outposts carrying messages no wire can be trusted with.
name: The Wayfarer — Foxwatch Traveler

traits.value: Work shirt and long striped scarf

description: He wears the Foxwatch jacket but follows his own map. The Rogue shows up exactly when he's needed and never when he's expected.
name: The Rogue — Foxwatch Outsider

description: Image rendered out of focus and unusable. Skipped from the batch.
name: Untitled — Foxwatch Reject

description: Muzzled, bug-eyed, and humming to himself. Nobody knows what the Oddball is guarding, but nothing has ever gotten past him.
name: The Oddball — Foxwatch Outcast

description: Every patrol log, every trail map, every name the Foxwatch has ever carried — the Archivist keeps them all, and remembers what the rest forgot.
name: The Archivist — Foxwatch Keeper

description: First through the brush, last to leave it. The Striker earned the name on the field and kept it on the trail.
name: The Striker — Foxwatch Vanguard

description: Boots, rations, spare scarves — if the Foxwatch needs it, the Quartermaster already packed two. Just don't ask where he got them.
name: The Quartermaster — Foxwatch Supply

description: Second in command of the dawn patrol. The Lieutenant doesn't raise his voice; the treeline just listens anyway.
name: The Lieutenant — Foxwatch Officer

description: The maps on his shoulder are drawn from memory, and his memory has never been wrong. The Cartographer knows trails that aren't on any chart.
name: The Cartographer — Foxwatch Scout Corps

description: Marked by the brush and unbothered by it. The Hunter reads broken twigs like headlines and has never lost a trail.
name: The Hunter — Foxwatch Tracker

description: Head in a book more often than on patrol. The Scholar insists the old field manuals hold answers the Foxwatch hasn't thought to ask for yet.
name: The Scholar — Foxwatch Scribe

description: Sketches every trailhead before the patrol moves. The Draftsman's ink-splattered field drawings have guided more night marches than any compass.
name: The Draftsman — Foxwatch Scout
